prov.heading: Provision for Credit Losses
prov.text: The provision for credit losses for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same period in 2025, increased by $232,000 primarily due to an increase in net loans receivable.

nonint.heading: Non-interest Expense
nonint.text:
The $230,000 increase in non-interest expense for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same period in 2025, resulted from increases of $138,000 in compensation and benefits, $100,000 in other real estate owned write-down expense, $76,000 in professional fees, $65,000 in audit and examination fees, $45,000 in advertising, and $11,000 in deposit insurance premium, partially offset by decreases of $100,000 in data processing, $46,000 in occupancy and equipment, $29,000 in franchise and bank shares tax, $17,000 in amortization of core deposit intangible, $9,000 in other expenses, and $4,000 in loan and collection expense. The $100,000 increase in other real estate owned write-down expense was related to the value of one large commercial property which was adjusted to reflect current market sentiment.

The aggregate compensation expense recognized by the Company for its stock options, share awards and employee stock ownership plan, amounted to $125,000 and $96,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025, respectively.

The Louisiana bank shares tax is assessed on the Bank’s equity and earnings. For the three months ended September 30, 2026, the Company recognized franchise and bank shares tax expense of $106,000 compared to $135,000, for the same period in 2025.

nonop.heading: Non-interest Expense
nonop.text:
The $230,000 increase in non-interest expense for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same period in 2025, resulted from increases of $138,000 in compensation and benefits, $100,000 in other real estate owned write-down expense, $76,000 in professional fees, $65,000 in audit and examination fees, $45,000 in advertising, and $11,000 in deposit insurance premium, partially offset by decreases of $100,000 in data processing, $46,000 in occupancy and equipment, $29,000 in franchise and bank shares tax, $17,000 in amortization of core deposit intangible, $9,000 in other expenses, and $4,000 in loan and collection expense. The $100,000 increase in other real estate owned write-down expense was related to the value of one large commercial property which was adjusted to reflect current market sentiment.

The aggregate compensation expense recognized by the Company for its stock options, share awards and employee stock ownership plan, amounted to $125,000 and $96,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025, respectively.

The Louisiana bank shares tax is assessed on the Bank’s equity and earnings. For the three months ended September 30, 2026, the Company recognized franchise and bank shares tax expense of $106,000 compared to $135,000, for the same period in 2025.

tax.heading: Income Taxes
tax.text: There was an income tax expense of $490,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2026, resulting in an effective tax rate of 20.4%. There was an income tax expense of $418,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2025, resulting in an effective tax rate of 20.7%.

net.text: The increase in net income for the three months ended September 30, 2026, as compared to the same period in 2025, resulted from an increase of $643,000, or 12.2%, in net interest income and an increase of $203,000, or 31.2%, in non-interest income, partially offset by an increase of $232,000, or 539.5%, in the provision for credit losses, an increase of $230,000, or 6.0%, in non-interest expense, and an increase of $72,000, or 17.2%, in the provision for income taxes.

da.text: Premises and equipment, net decreased $153,000, or 0.9%, to $16.020 million at September 30, 2026 compared to $16.173 million at June 30, 2026, due to depreciation.

Net interest income.heading: Net Interest Income
Net interest income.text: The increase in net interest income for the three months ended September 30, 2026, as compared to the same period in 2025, resulted from an increase of $687,000, or 8.6%, in total interest income, partially offset by an increase of $44,000, or 1.6%, in total interest expense. The Company’s average interest rate spread was 3.17% for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to 2.99% for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The Company’s net interest margin was 3.83% for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to 3.63% for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

profile.name: Home Federal Bancorp, Inc. of Louisiana

intro.text: Home Federal Bancorp, Inc. of Louisiana, a Louisiana chartered corporation (“Home Federal Bancorp” or the “Company”), is the holding company for Home Federal Bank (“Home Federal Bank” or the “Bank”). Home Federal Bank is a federally chartered stock savings bank originally organized in 1924 as Home Building and Loan Association. The Bank reorganized into the mutual holding company structure in January 2005 and changed its name to “Home Federal Bank” in 2009 as part of its business strategy to be recognized as a community bank. Home Federal Bank’s home office and ten full service branch offices are located in Caddo, Bossier and Webster Parishes, Louisiana and serve the Shreveport-Bossier City-Minden combined statistical area. In February 2023, the Bank acquired First National Bank of Benton and its full service branch office in Benton, Louisiana.
